proposals.reason: Auto-core configuration (F4/F5). compare never writes state, ledger or journal; it records would_apply and counts the compare streak. Switching to apply (deployment step 6, the user's "켜") is a change of this one field. kill_switch true stops the run before any Kiwoom read. Without this file the core still runs read-only in compare mode and reports HOLD AUTO_CORE_CONFIG_MISSING.

f6_note: F6 (acceptance pin retirement) needs no workspace/policies change: no runtime path reads the pin (0단계 a). The pin scope asset is kept and marked RETIRED; the commit SHA and dirty-path guard lives in the auto-core code.

not_a_policy_but_needed.reason: Auto-core run outputs (result.json, reconcile.json, proposal, snapshot, logs) are generated data like workspace/outputs/reconciliation/ and workspace/outputs/exposure-review/, which are already ignored. Outside the Builder's allowed paths, so it is listed here for Cowork.
